I replied in #coastal-team, addressed to you. I did not set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

The scheduler available to me runs only from this session and can't post into Slack, so a scheduled job would never appear in the channel. I can post a "Coastal week ahead" digest for #coastal-team and #coastal-random by hand whenever you ask. Those digests will leave out money terms like discounts, pricing and contract values, because both channels are wider than the finance audience.
